engine_gaps.name: GrindingSurfaceFinishEngine
engine_gaps.description: Surface grinding finish prediction — no engine computes expected Ra/Rz from wheel+material+params. GrindingForceEngine exists but only handles force/power.
engine_gaps.evidence: GrindingForceEngine covers force only. 3 catalogs available (Metalmorphosis, Cutting Tools Master). 0 learning sources for grinding.

engine_gaps.name: DrillCycleOptimizationEngine
engine_gaps.description: Peck drilling cycle optimization — drill cycle selection (standard/peck/gun), chip break parameters, dwell times. DrillBreakthroughForceEngine only handles exit force.
engine_gaps.evidence: DrillBreakthroughForceEngine exists but no cycle selection. 4 drilling catalogs available (GC Drilling, OSG, Holemaking, guhring). 0 learning sources for drilling.

engine_gaps.name: ThreadMillingEngine
engine_gaps.description: Thread milling parameter engine — thread mill vs tap selection, helix interpolation, radial engagement. ThreadCalculationEngine handles geometry but not thread milling CAM params.
engine_gaps.evidence: ThreadCalculationEngine + SinglePointThreadEngine exist but no thread milling. Threading catalog + EMUGE catalog available.

engine_gaps.name: ToolCoatingSelectionEngine
engine_gaps.description: Coating selection for material/operation — TiAlN vs AlCrN vs TiN vs uncoated, temperature limits, friction coefficients.
engine_gaps.evidence: No coating engine exists. Multiple tool catalogs have coating data. Key for tool life optimization.

engine_gaps.name: ToolGeometrySelectionEngine
engine_gaps.description: End mill geometry selection — flute count, helix angle, corner radius, variable helix. Currently no engine maps material+operation to optimal geometry.
engine_gaps.evidence: ToolAssemblyEngine handles holder geometry only. 10+ endmill catalogs available with geometry recommendations per material.

engine_gaps.name: InsertGradeSelectionEngine
engine_gaps.description: Insert grade selection for turning — map material class to ISO insert grade (P/M/K/N/S/H), substrate, coating. TurningForceEngine computes forces but no grade selection.
engine_gaps.evidence: 3 turning catalogs available. TurningForceEngine exists but no grade/insert selection.

engine_gaps.name: CoolantStrategyEngine
engine_gaps.description: Coolant strategy selection — flood vs MQL vs through-tool vs dry, pressure/flow recommendations by material+operation. CoolantValidationEngine validates but doesn't recommend.
engine_gaps.evidence: CoolantValidationEngine exists for validation. No recommendation engine. Shop practices have coolant rules but no structured engine.

algorithm_gaps.name: ToolSelectionAlgorithm
algorithm_gaps.description: Material+operation -> optimal tool geometry+coating+grade. No algorithm maps the full selection chain.
algorithm_gaps.evidence: Catalogs have per-material recommendations. 8 tips reference tool selection.

algorithm_gaps.name: ProcessPlanningAlgorithm
algorithm_gaps.description: Feature list -> operation sequence. No algorithm generates an operation order from part features.
algorithm_gaps.evidence: Operation sequences field exists in strategy_db but is empty.
